# TerraTrade

> TerraTrade is a trading company based in Kano, Nigeria (established 2023). It sources, processes and packages Nigerian agri-commodities and hardwood charcoal to international quality standards and exports them to buyers in the Middle East (Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Lebanon, Syria) and Asia (Japan, South Korea, China).

## Products
- Food-grade crops: sesame seeds, raw cashew nuts (in shell), dried hibiscus flower, soybean
- Animal feed: wheat bran
- Wood-based products: hardwood lump charcoal

## Operations
- Two logistical hubs: north (Kano: food-crop sourcing) and south (Lagos: animal-feed sourcing next to the export seaport)
- Annual capacity: 5,000+ MT
